stories.title: Integrate Specialty Identification with Provider Search Pipeline
stories.description: Integrate specialty_service outputs into provider_search_service to ensure NUCC codes are correctly consumed for taxonomy fallback and combined vector+taxonomy search flows.

stories.title: Implement Query Expansion via Embedding Client
stories.description: Wire specialty identification to embedding_client for AI-driven query expansion, ensuring expanded terms improve recall without introducing irrelevant specialties.

stories.title: Add Logging and Traceability for Specialty Resolution
stories.description: Log specialty identification steps including input query, regex matches, vector matches, and final NUCC codes for debugging and auditability using debug_logger.

stories.title: Handle Ambiguous and Multi-Specialty Queries
stories.description: Enhance specialty_service to robustly handle ambiguous inputs (e.g., 'heart doctor') and multi-specialty queries by returning ranked or grouped NUCC codes.
